title: Scout (Phase I audit, part 2): matrix of phase-i-program.md P1-P7 against source and tests; findings as structured entries
spec: Objective: implementation-map audit, continuation of T-0562 whose P0 lines survived (all P0 metrics implemented_tested) but whose P1-P7 lines were cut off because bus results truncate the summary field at 2000 characters. Put EACH matrix line as its own entry in the result's findings list (dict with keys finding, source, confidence, relevance) and keep the summary to one sentence. Cover ONLY Phase I P1-P7 from .orchestrator/phase-i-program.md, at most 18 findings, each under 220 characters: 'PI.P<n>.<key> | <status> | <file:line> | <tests or none> | <gap <=10 words>' with status in implemented_tested | implemented_undertested | partial | missing | experimental_gated. Decide from SOURCE and tests/. P1 packets: which roles have deterministic packets (spawn.py _packet_body 181-353, review_packet 412-490, spec_review_packet 494, scout_packet 513, daemon._fix_round_delta 536, planner_runs.decision_packet 43); is there a challenge packet; is input size measured per role (packet_run_meta 360); how stale reuse is prevented (hash/base). P2: scorecard economics columns (scorecard.py expected_cost 98, class_success 64, efficiency 987, _efficiency_summary 954) and executor.resume_plan 185 for resume preservation. P3/P4: jev_route.py classify 96 (cache, budget, timeout, malformed, privacy via jev.redact, single eligible skip), hypothetical 146, shadow_context 165 (active is a notification stub at 167-171?), record_shadow 178; jev_rank.py; which of these have tests in tests/test_jev_route.py, test_jev_rank.py, test_jev.py: off, shadow, active, unavailable, timeout, malformed, budget exhausted, single eligible, multiple eligible, cooldown, sparse scorecard, strong historical evidence, strong conflicting Jev signal, cache and invalidation, shadow never changes routing, failure reproduces baseline; is there a routing evaluation report (grep routing_eval, --routing in scorecard.py/cli.py) comparing baseline vs hypothetical against first-pass/fix rounds/cost. P5: active ranking implemented or stub. P6: complementary roles (daemon._open_reviews 1004-1049 reviewer_role, _load_review_cfg 217) and overlap telemetry (scorecard.review_quality 838); smallest sufficient review packet measured? P7: any Jev decision point for scout necessity, context escalation, review escalation, planner relaunch (planner_runs.jev_triage 432, decision.py). Last finding: 'UNCERTAIN: ...'. Budget: read only the cited line ranges plus grep; do not read whole files.
acceptance: Findings list holds one entry per Phase I P1-P7 requirement, at most 18, each with status, file:line, tests, gap
Summary is one sentence; no entry over 220 characters
Statuses derived from source and tests

result.summary: Posted result for T-0573 (status: done). 18 findings covering Phase I P1–P7: P1–P2 fully implemented_tested (packets, economics, resume); P3 shadow classification tested but shadow-isolation and active mode are undertested/stubbed; P4 has telemetry logging but no evaluation report/CLI; P5 active ranking is a notify() stub only; P6 complementary reviews shipped but gated off by default; P7 flagged UNCERTAIN — `planner_runs.jev_triage` covers three generic decision kinds (scouts_done/held/closable), not clearly the four named P7 points, and `decision.py` has zero Jev references.

Phase I P1-P7 audit: P1-P2 fully implemented_tested, P3 shadow routing tested but isolation/active untested, P4 telemetry exists with no evaluation report, P5/P7 remain stub/gated, P6 shipped but gated off by default.
